steps.say: This is how a trial becomes a paid school. You pay per teacher seat, and one subscription covers every language and every class those teachers run.
Choose Monthly or Annual above — annual works out at two months free per seat — then set the seat count with the stepper. It opens at the number of teachers who have actually joined.
**Subscribe** opens the card panel on this page, and you come back to your dashboard with the subscription live. Seats are teacher seats, not student seats: your students do not each need one.
steps.terminal: That is the school plan — teacher seats, one subscription, no second checkout. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
